summary: Build practical well diagnostics, artificial lift, and surveillance skills. Enquire now for a 5-day intermediate course.
lede: Oil and gas production optimization uses well data and operating evidence to find constraints and improve deliverability while protecting safety and integrity. This course is for professionals working with well performance, production data, or field operations, and develops skills in interpreting nodal analysis and surveillance patterns, assessing artificial lift, and prioritizing interventions within operational constraints.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with well performance, production data, or field operations and now need a structured approach to improve output.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working understanding of oil and gas production operations, well equipment, and basic production terminology. Familiarity with spreadsheets, well test data, and core concepts such as pressure, flow rate, and artificial lift will help you move faster through the exercises. No coding is required, but comfort reading dashboards, production reports, and maintenance records will support the hands-on work. Participants should bring a laptop capable of running spreadsheet-based analysis and viewing sample field datasets.
